mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_message (sender_id, receiver_id, apply_id, content, is_read) VALUES (#{senderId}, #{receiverId}, #{applyId}, #{content}, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM chat_message WHERE (sender_id = #{userId} AND receiver_id = #{otherUserId}) OR (sender_id = #{otherUserId} AND receiver_id = #{userId}) ORDER BY create_time ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_message WHERE receiver_id = #{userId} AND is_read = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_message SET is_read = 1 WHERE receiver_id = #{userId} AND sender_id = #{otherUserId} AND is_read = 0
